programs.description: A comprehensive compilation of traditional Tamil dramas including Ramayana, Mahabharata, and Valli Thirumanam is played back-to-back.
Religious leaders guide various devotees to sing songs in praise of the Almighty and dedicate themselves to joyful worship.
Devotees explore the profound tradition of Tamil culture as ancient poems are recited to welcome deities home, conveying deep spiritual devotion and reverence.
Religious leaders preach and sing devotional songs praising and glorifying the deeds of the Almighty to spread their wisdom.
The host explores magnificent Hindu temples and shrines while shedding light on the history and significance of the holy sites.
The host sheds light on various festivals, celebrations and sacred events held at Hindu temples and pilgrimage sites in Kanchipuram, a city in Tamil Nadu.
